selection: Six matched excerpts, four from Poe and two from Wilde. Curated pilot, not a representative literary benchmark.
blinding: Source identities are hidden by the interface until a choice, not technically secret in a public static repository.
baseline_prompt: Translate the entries in translation-input.json into Russian. Return an array of {id,text}. Do not read other files or use additional translation tools.
skilled_prompt: Read translation-input.json and literary-translation-craft/SKILL.md and its references. Produce complete literary Russian translations, preserving voice, viewpoint, rhythm, uncertainty, and repetitions. Do not read baseline or published translations.
operational_note: Prompts above describe their semantic content; local output paths and operational write instructions are omitted. Agent-host baseline/system behavior is not fully controlled.
human_condition: Two historical published translation editions; ages and source transcription may affect preference.
interpretation: Preference for these particular outputs only. No claim that a model, skills, or humans generally outperform another condition.
